cfg.day_length.name: Day Length
cfg.day_length.desc: Set the length of a day.
cfg.debug_logging.name: Debug Logging
cfg.debug_logging.desc: Write day-cycle diagnostics to the BepInEx console: the day number and the corpse-delivery chance each day. Useful for reporting delivery issues. Leave off for normal play.
cfg.check_for_updates.name: Check for Updates
cfg.check_for_updates.desc: Show a notice on the main menu when a newer version of this mod is available on NexusMods. Click the notice to open the mod's page.
